notes.title: ELDER UPDATE
notes.notes:
💀 New Difficulty: Elder


Think you’ve mastered the bar? Think again. Elder is here to test your limits. This new difficulty level is all about tighter margins, harsher penalties, and survival at all costs.

Sell off your extras, trade research points, and stay above water financially! You’ll need to optimize every drop because the stakes have never been higher. 

Will you be able to build a profitable business under harsh conditions?



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862256/d23cc3eeb34b7289742749d103fc57f3b23a3b7f.png"]

Key Features:

🧛‍♂️ Limited number of minions

⚙️ Machines settings really matter

🕵️‍♂️ Constant spawn of investigators & hunters

🩸 Blood production is harder to optimize

🧾 Side quests give fewer rewards

💸 Increased charges across the board

🧨 Balancing your finances is critical


🧠 Reworked Tech Tree + Automation Tab


Many players ask for it and we heard you! The Tech Tree has been completely overhauled with smarter layout, clearer perks and a brand new Automation Tab for your quality-of-undead-life.

Now you can:

🩸 Auto-sell blood when inventory hits a threshold

🧃 Auto-buy drinks for your human guests

🧬 Auto-sell research points

Also added: shelves, fridges, and special perks just for Elder players.


📺 Twitch Integration


Let your viewers become part of the chaos! With our new Twitch integration, chat usernames can now show up as customers in-game. Surprise shoutouts guaranteed.


⚒️ The Minion's Revolt Has Begun


Gone are the days of silent suffering. Unhappy minions will now quit unless you bring up the cash. Manage morale carefully or face the consequences.


✨ Machines, But Prettier


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862256/0ab0ab68310a6588a6a549b5faa6a7cef69b9119.gif"]



We’ve visually upgraded every major machine. Not only do they perform better post-upgrade—you’ll unlock exclusive visual skins with each level.


🍸 A More Immersive Blood Bar


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862256/91580de1f858aab6aad6110049e6aaf8a95f37b4.gif"]



More interactive elements, livelier decor, and a fully enhanced atmosphere for every bar theme. Whether you’re into cyberpunk, tiki, or vampire chic we’ve got something for you.


🔧 Quality of life + Balance Changes

✚ Added:
Worker satisfaction now triggers bonus requests

New barks for unhappy customers & minions

New Difficulty: Elder

Sinks and dryers now usable by humans

Twitch integration

Visual upgrades for all major machines (Distiller, Shaker, Tea Bag, etc.)

New decorative objects for every theme (Art Deco, Cyberpunk, Vampire, etc.)

New Automation Tech Tree tab

New perks: shelf, fridge, delivery speed, cost reduction, etc.

Elder-exclusive perks: increase worker cap, reduce Abyssal Wrath cooldown


🔁 Changed:
Improved quest readability (Steam Deck compatibility)

Better mission descriptions for locked content

Side quests, tech points, and blood harvesting now more balanced on all difficulties

Elder Difficulty only:

Increased Abyssal cooldown

Decreased tech/blood rewards

Constant enemy spawn

Lower vigilance cap

Tighter loan conditions

Rent, quests, and Maeve services are pricier

Machines less productive

Worker cap reduced (can be raised via tech tree)

Reworked navmesh on all theme furniture to avoid blocking characters


🐛 Fixed:
Customers no longer get stuck on decor

Prestige rates corrected for:

Disco theme

Biker theme

70’s decorations

Art Deco plants



We continue to sharpen the fangs of Blood Bar Tycoon, thanks to your persistent screeches and your cursed bug reports. Keep sending them through the in-game report tool, our Discord coven, or the old-fashioned email scroll: hello@clevertrickster.com

 If you’ve enjoyed our efforts or at least didn’t perish of rage leave us a positive review. It feeds the Steam algorithm and keeps my minions alive (barely).  Until the next nightfall… 



 Stay ruthless, stay bloodthirsty,   



Vladimir de la Ligne  



Your ever-demanding undead overlord

notes.title: New Patch is Here! Ready for Bug Fixes, UX & Beta Secrets?

Greetings, children of the night!

We're thrilled to bring you our latest patch! Our goal is to push Blood Bar Tycoon back above 80% positive reviews on Steam.

Like Goku, we need your energy to create these Genki Dama powerful patches and make the game perfect for you! Remember, we hear you, and your feedback is always welcome—leave a comment here or, even better, join us on Discord!

Fixed:

 Throwing a body bag into the Dip no longer visually bugs future body bags.
 Customers trying to talk to each other should be less likely to get stuck.
 Further improvements to pathfinding in maps with a large amount of furniture.
 Minions should now properly feed themselves when blood is available.
 Vampires should always attack humans when their hunger reaches 0.
 Fixed an issue with a quest in level 6 that would break service upon completion.
 Loading a map with an invalid construction now properly displays alerts and locks the time.
 Minions should no longer get stuck while trying to clean puddles.
 Minions should no longer attempt to grab drinks that have already been delivered.
 When loading a save, need bubbles for vampire customers should still appear red.

Added:

Didn't see anything about the building system in this patch? Don't worry—we're working on it in the Beta branch! You can join the Beta branch using the password: VladimirIsTheBoss.

And yes, we're figuring out how to create partial walls or dividers to build cozy alcoves! You want it so badly, so we’ll make it happen—promise!

If you have a special request for our next patch, leave us a comment here—we welcome all suggestions! And remember, the more positive reviews we get, the more we can keep working hard to improve the game. So help us make Blood Bar Tycoon perfect!

Have a fangtastic evening,

The Clever Trickster Team

notes.title: Bug Fixes - Construction - 6 Months of Post-Launch Support
notes.notes:
Greetings, Children of the Night,

Many of you have expressed concerns about bugs and other issues you've encountered, and we want to share our plan to fix everything.

First, we’d like to thank you for your support both before and during the launch. Those positive reviews on Steam mean a lot to us, and we hope to read even more of them! I carefully read every review, both positive and negative. This is our first game as a studio—we’ve poured our love, tears, and blood into it. It’s been quite a journey, and we’re proud of what we’ve achieved as a team. But it’s not perfect yet, and we’re working hard to improve it!

Despite extensive QA testing, some pesky bugs still slipped through the net—and that makes us angry. We want to fix them all and become the best bug hunters in the world! Sounds like a Pokémon pitch, but seriously, we're on it. To address the issues, we’ll be deploying several hotfixes—daily if possible—to tackle the most critical problems. That’s our first move.

Some of you have also expressed concerns about our resources for both fixing bugs and adding new content. We originally budgeted at least six months of post-launch support, even if the game wasn’t a success. But so far, the launch has been great! Blood Bar Tycoon has appeared in News & Trending, Top Sellers, and even front-page sliders—all thanks to you. So, we promise to fix the issues and add new content. We just ask for a little patience, as we’re an indie team working as fast as possible while avoiding burnout (because exhaustion leads to bugs—it’s the dark side of game development).

Now, let’s talk about the biggest concern: the construction system. We attempted a hybrid between the Two Point series and The Sims, and in hindsight, it may not have been the best approach. The system needs a major overhaul, but we’ll tackle that after addressing the most critical issues. To ensure we create a system you enjoy, we’ll run beta tests on Discord and QQ, so you can give us direct feedback. We believe involving more of you in this process is the right move. What do you think of this idea?

If you love the game but don’t love the bugs and other issues (trust us, we don’t either), here’s how you can help:


 Use the built-in tool to report issues for our QA.
 Join our Discord or QQ so we can assist you directly and pinpoint issues faster (we’ll owe you one!).
 Leave a positive review and mention your concerns (bad reviews won’t help us fix things—quite the opposite).


Thank you for your understanding, and I look forward to chatting with you on Discord!

Ludovic
Lead Game Designer of Blood Bar Tycoon

notes.title: New Release Date Announcement and a Milestone Reached
notes.notes:
Good evening, Fangs lovers,

Today, I come with both good and bad news! The good news is that we've reached the Demo stage, and for that, we owe a huge thanks to all our Alpha and Beta testers. Your feedback has greatly helped us improve the demo and the entire game!

We’ve been thrilled to receive so many fantastic ideas to enhance the game! While we won’t be able to include all of them by the initial deadline of October 28th, we’re committed to delivering the best possible experience. To achieve this, we’ve secured additional resources and have decided to extend the launch date to Tuesday, February 4th, 2025. This extra time will ensure we can fully integrate your feedback and make the game truly exceptional. We’re excited to share this final and definitive version with you!

Some of you have also asked about the price of the full game. Here is the official information: it will be priced at $19.99.

notes.title: Open beta launch - Patch 0.1.01956-240911
notes.notes:
Good afternoon, Fangs lovers,

The Tuesday patch was delayed and has become a Wednesday patch, but what a patch it is! We've completed the save system in the game, allowing you to save your best bars and continue enjoying them (among other things)! But that’s not all: now that we've reached this stage, we're officially in the Open Beta phase. We're still working on ‘quality of life’ improvements leading up to the release!

Here’s what you can expect from today’s patch:

Fixed:

 The 2 starting workers must now also be paid a salary.
 Fixed an issue with dialogues not starting and soft-locking quests.
 Improved contextual menu display.
 The Furniture UI should no longer randomly close when placing furniture.
 Humans should no longer try to talk to customers in vampire-only rooms.
 Workers can no longer pick up a body that is currently being picked up by another worker.
 Changing scenes while in the Vamp'Hire agency will no longer break the camera.

Changed:

 The Furniture Shop now auto-closes when opening the Pause Menu to avoid saving unplaced furniture.
 Tweaked a few UI elements.
 Updated some text and localizations.
 Improved selection colliders for the Cell.

Added:

 Save system.
 Button in the furniture list to toggle the Theme filter.
 Updated placement feedback on furniture.
 Added a new alert when room assignments prevent customers from reaching a room (e.g. when a Worker-only room is the only path between two customer rooms).
 New objective in mission 11 asking players to enlarge a room.
 Consideration of the prestige level to unlock a bank loan.
 Enabled Japanese and Chinese localization in the settings.


Stay tuned for more updates, and know that your feedback is most welcome. Join our Discord or use the built-in report system.

Have a lovely night!
The Clever Trickster Team

 Pressing the space bar in the Report System UI no longer resumes/pauses the game.
 Blood Distiller Icon (TechTree).
